outcome: death (due to mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation deficiency)
cohort: The study analyzed 18 patients diagnosed with Acute Fatty Liver of Pregnancy (AFLP) and their infants, identified from 142,450 pregnancies over 18 years in three French maternities.
finding: Prolonged prothrombin time was identified as a risk factor for maternal complications, and gestational age at delivery was associated with fetal or neonate complications in patients with Acute Fatty Liver of Pregnancy (AFLP).
